title: Chapter 43
content:
Chapter 43

"The host already has a population of 10,000 and a territory of hundreds of miles around. It has reached the standard of establishing its own country. I also ask the host to name its own country to show the existence of its own power."

Hearing the host's request, Zhong Yu thought for a moment.

Give me a name, what should I call it? From the point of view of the exercises I have practiced, it is very appropriate to be called Tianting.

Those in the heavenly court rule the heavens and the world, regulate the yin and yang of the heaven and the earth, intimidate the powerful, and spread their majesty in the world.

But now, his own strength is not worthy of this title, and it can even be said that he is not worthy of it.

Once he called out this name, it would be too enviable and eye-catching, and it didn't fit his current situation.

If I want to hand over this name, I must at least reach the level of immortal god level, so that I can barely protect myself. When I call this Heavenly Court, it will barely be worthy of the name.

Heavenly Court, to put it bluntly, isn't it an emperor among the gods, ruling over all the gods? I am a god, and there are gods under my command, so what is wrong with calling heaven!

On my side of the world, the gods manifested their holiness, the extraordinary rampant, many great powers descended on the world, and the gods harvested the faith and soul of the people.

It's not that the first-class existence of the true god can't spread his beliefs until he has this kind of strength.

The aborigines who called themselves Tianting had never heard of the existence of the Eastern Immortal Court, maybe they thought it was the name of a kind of god!

Then it is decided like this, set off an ordinary country name, and wait until you have the power of a god, then it will be called Tianting!

What is the name? Great Qin, Great Han, Great Tang, or Huaxia.

No, I don't like to pick up other people's leftovers. These have been used by countless senior traversers, or the ancients in my own world.

It's not my character to pick up broken shoes, let's come up with my own original name that belongs to me!

Then let’s do this, use your own name as the country’s name, as if many people in ancient times did this, and call it Yu, the Great Yu Empire.

The ruler, control, rule, what the emperor does.

It has been an incomparably noble word since ancient times, and it has been placed on the voice of the emperor continuously, symbolizing the supremacy of the ruler.

Using this word, even if one's own name is also one's own country title, isn't that why one secretly wants to become an emperor?

"System, the name of the country is Yuba, Great Yu Empire, I am the Lord of Great Yu, Di Yu!" Zhong Yu's voice full of heavy and excitement sounded in his heart.

"The country name is established, please host to choose the totem of the country as a symbol of the country."

Totem? What totem should I call it? Dragon, no, I don't like creatures like dragons. Throughout the ages, many emperors have used dragons as totems, which is too popular.

Since I want to be his unique emperor of heaven, I will establish the supreme heaven. Destined to go alone, away from all the crowd, alone.

Then choose Liniao! Those who are away from the bird, the bird who is lost in the flock, isn't it just right for you?

However, Li Niao, cyan, I don't like, too soft and weak, no aggressive intentions.

It is better to add a layer of red fire that surrounds the whole body to show its aggressiveness. If I am like this, I can be regarded as creating a totem!

Just right, among the eight trigrams and five elements, the one who leaves is fire. The name of the totem coincides with the seal he added, it can be said that it is a perfect match.

"The totem has been selected. Congratulations to the host, you have officially established your own country, and you have taken the first step to become king and emperor, and to fight for world hegemony. The basic information of the country can be viewed on the personal power panel."

The voice is still so cold and ruthless, but Zhong Yu sounds so sweet, he finally has his own country, this is his foundation!

I opened my personal panel, and a few words were hanging on the blue screen.

Country Name: Imperial

National Totem: Li Bird

National population: 13,500 people (not shown below 100 people)

Land area: a radius of one hundred and fifty miles

Administrative division: County 1, Township 5, Pavilion 11

National army: regular army 100, militia 700, servant army 300

Although the introduction was very simple, it allowed me to understand the whole situation of my territory intuitively and clearly, and I also had a general assessment and understanding of my own strength.

"The host officially established his own country, and practiced the emperor's skills, successfully opened a greater authority, obtained the function of traveling through the heavens and worlds, plundering all walks of life to feed himself, and rewarded the host with 1000 luck points, as The start-up funds for national construction. Please also check the host in time."

Wait, what, I can travel through, haven't I already traveled to this world? He also travels through the heavens and worlds, is this his biggest golden finger?

My situation in this world is very unfavorable, the gods in the sky are flying all over the sky, the legends on the ground are not as good as dogs, and I may be wiped out by someone else with a finger at any time.

But now he can travel to various worlds. If he travels through those small worlds first, plunders luck points from them, and uses them to feed himself back, then the power of his territory should grow very quickly!

Then let's take a look for yourself, how to time travel, and what conditions are there for time travel!

Take a look, there are probably a few points that need attention.

The first point is that I can obtain a world traversal with the same strength as myself once a year. For example, if your current highest strength is only at the second level, then you will only travel to the second or third level. It will definitely not travel to the fourth or fifth level, a world where the power has undergone qualitative changes.

The second point is that you can spend luck points to choose, but only once a month. This kind of choice is more vague, let's use the lowest level of 100,000 luck points as an example. 100,000 luck points can only travel to worlds without extraordinary power, and 1 million are needed to travel to worlds below the third level. In the upward direction, those worlds with divine creatures but no real gods will need 10 million, and the rest will be analogized.

The third point is that I can spend some luck points so that the army under my command that I exchanged from the system can enter that world with me and help me conquer that world. It depends on the specific luck.

Zhong Yu summed it up, there are probably three points that need to be paid attention to, and the others are some irrelevant things.

To cross the world, the lowest level of world crossing requires 100,000 luck points, and you can only choose some worlds without extraordinary power.

I currently have a population of 10,000 in my territory, and I can only get 275 luck points for the most luck points per month. It will take at least thirty years to collect the luck points for one time travel. This is not for my consideration, so I can let it go open.

Then you can only use the one opportunity that is given away for free every year. This is free, and the ones that can be drawn are also random, but I don’t know what world will come out.

It's best to let yourself just conquer, or get a lot of benefits, as long as you can achieve one of the two, then you won't be considered a loss.

Well, since this is the case, let yourself have a look at your luck, and let the system decide what world you can draw!

"System, I want to use the opportunity to travel through the world to draw immediately."
